readme:
# ValzzHost — Lightweight Ubuntu SSH for Railway

![ValzzHost](https://img101.pixhost.cc/images/77/546441106_skyzopedia.jpg)

Ubuntu 24.04 SSH server with **Node.js 26 LTS** + **PM2**. For persistence, attach a Railway Volume at `/data`.

## Deploy Steps
1. Set **ROOT_PASSWORD** (required) in Variables
2. Add **TCP Proxy** on port `22` (Settings → Networking)
3. Redeploy, then connect:

```bash
ssh root@<your-railway-domain> -p <port>
```

## Persistent storage
Attach a Railway Volume to this service and set its mount path to `/data`. Without this, user files and PM2 state are ephemeral.

## Variables
- `ROOT_PASSWORD` (**required**) — root password
- `VALZZ_HOSTNAME` (recommended) — custom Linux hostname
- `SSH_USERNAME` + `SSH_PASSWORD` (optional) — secondary user with sudo (password required by default)
- `AUTHORIZED_KEYS` (optional) — SSH public keys for root
- `SSH_USER_AUTHORIZED_KEYS` (optional) — SSH public keys for the secondary user
- `SSH_PASSWORD_AUTH` (optional, default `true`) — SSH password login switch
- `SSH_ROOT_LOGIN` (optional, default `yes`) — root SSH login mode
- `SSH_SUDO_NOPASSWD` (optional, default `false`) — passwordless sudo switch
- `NODE_OPTIONS` (optional) — Node.js runtime options

## Included
- Node.js 26.x + npm
- PM2 (global)
- neofetch, git, htop, tmux, vim, nano

Support: https://t.me/Valzz_Multi_Platform_Dev

© ValzzHost

ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Strong root password. Update this Railway Variable (not only passwd inside the container) when changing it.

VALZZ_HOSTNAME.description: Required custom Linux hostname. Example: valzzhost. Letters, numbers, dots and hyphens only.

SSH_USERNAME.description: Optional secondary user. Must be set together with SSH_PASSWORD.

SSH_PASSWORD.description: Password for the optional secondary user. Set together with SSH_USERNAME.

AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: SSH public key(s) for root key-based authentication.

SSH_USER_AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: Optional public SSH key(s) for the secondary SSH user.

SSH_PASSWORD_AUTH.description: Enable or disable SSH password authentication. Defaults to true; set false after key login is verified.

SSH_ROOT_LOGIN.description: Root SSH login mode: yes, no, or prohibit-password. Defaults to yes.

SSH_SUDO_NOPASSWD.description: Set true to grant the secondary user passwordless sudo. Defaults to false.

NODE_OPTIONS.description: Optional Node.js runtime options such as --max-old-space-size=2048. Set according to actual RAM.
